en.summary: This commit fixes operand-output routing by arbitrating multiple collector outputs into one dispatch stream before the downstream issue and dispatch logic.
why_it_counts: It changes the active collector-to-dispatch control path in the DUT.
The patch introduces the missing serialization point when several operand collectors can complete concurrently.
The failure mode is generic and readily reusable on other multi-producer dispatch front-ends.
evidence: VX_dispatch.sv and VX_issue_slice.sv change operands_if from an array of interfaces to a single interface.
VX_operands.sv introduces per_opc_operands_if and a VX_stream_arb that merges collector outputs into one operands_if stream.
The new arbiter is the only logic added between per-collector outputs and the single downstream operands_if.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: If several operand collectors or issue sources feed one downstream dispatch port, there must be an explicit many-to-one arbitration or serialization stage. Without it, simultaneous completions either contend electrically or logically, or one producer silently wins while others are dropped. The fix adds that missing merge point before dispatch.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Two or more collectors become valid in the same cycle while only one downstream dispatch input exists.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove or bypass the arbitration stage that serializes multiple collector outputs onto the single downstream stream.
portability_notes: This applies to any issue front-end with multiple operand collectors, replay sources, or execution queues feeding one consumer.
The bug is easiest to observe when multiple collectors finish in the same cycle.
The mutation should be applied before the shared dispatch or issue queue input, not after it.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the interface where several operand collectors feed one downstream dispatch or issue stream.
Find the stream arbiter, mux, or grant logic that turns those producers into a single valid-ready channel.
Remove that arbitration or replace it with direct forwarding from only one producer.
Keep the downstream consumer unchanged so it still expects one well-formed input stream.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: collector outputs merged into a single operands_if stream
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix creates per_opc_operands_if in VX_operands.sv and adds a VX_stream_arb to merge them into one operands_if, with matching interface changes in VX_dispatch.sv and VX_issue_slice.sv.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In hw/rtl/core/VX_operands.sv, remove the operands_arb merge stage and forward only one collector output directly to operands_if.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Operand packets are dropped, collide nondeterministically, or reach dispatch from the wrong collector, causing missing or mis-issued instructions.
evidence_for_injection: The downstream modules are changed to consume a single operands_if instead of an array.
The new VX_stream_arb is the functional bridge between multiple collectors and that single consumer.
No test-only or software files are involved.
notes: A single-file mutation in VX_operands.sv is enough to recreate the architectural bug pattern on this repository.
This fault is most visible under concurrent collector completions.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了操作数输出路由：在进入下游 issue 和 dispatch 逻辑之前，先把多个 collector 输出仲裁成一条单独的 dispatch 流。
why_it_counts: 它修改了 DUT 中从 collector 到 dispatch 的实际控制路径。
该补丁补上了当多个操作数收集器可能并发完成时必需的串行化合并点。
这种失效模式是通用的，也容易迁移到其他多生产者前端。
evidence: VX_dispatch.sv 和 VX_issue_slice.sv 把 operands_if 从接口数组改成了单一接口。
VX_operands.sv 引入 per_opc_operands_if，并新增 VX_stream_arb 把多个 collector 输出合并为一个 operands_if 流。
新增的仲裁器是多个 collector 输出与单一下游 operands_if 之间唯一新增的功能逻辑。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 如果多个操作数收集器或 issue 来源要共享一个下游 dispatch 端口，就必须有明确的多对一仲裁或串行化阶段。否则当它们同时完成时，就会出现逻辑争用，或者只有一个来源被悄悄保留、其他来源被丢弃。该修复就是在 dispatch 前补上这个缺失的合并点。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 两个或更多 collector 在同一周期 valid，而下游只有一个 dispatch 输入时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 删除或绕过把多个 collector 输出串行化到单一下游流上的仲裁阶段。
portability_notes: 这适用于任何由多个操作数收集器、重放源或执行队列共同驱动一个消费者的 issue 前端。
当多个 collector 在同一周期同时完成时最容易观察到该错误。
故障应注入在共享 dispatch 或 issue 队列输入之前，而不是之后。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位多个操作数收集器汇入单一下游 dispatch 或 issue 流的接口。
找到负责把多个生产者转成单条 valid-ready 通道的流仲裁器、mux 或 grant 逻辑。
删除该仲裁逻辑，或改成只把某一个生产者直接转发给下游。
保持下游消费者不变，让它继续假定自己接收的是一条正确串行化的输入流。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 多个 collector 输出合并成单一 operands_if 流
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在 VX_operands.sv 中创建 per_opc_operands_if，并加入 VX_stream_arb 把它们合并为一个 operands_if；VX_dispatch.sv 和 VX_issue_slice.sv 也相应改成单接口消费。
repository_grounding.mutation_strategy: 删除 collector 输出仲裁
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 hw/rtl/core/VX_operands.sv 中，去掉 operands_arb 合并阶段，只把单个 collector 输出直接送到 operands_if。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 操作数包会被丢弃、发生非确定性冲突，或从错误的 collector 进入 dispatch，导致指令发射缺失或发射错误。
evidence_for_injection: 下游模块被改成只消费单个 operands_if，而不是数组。
新增的 VX_stream_arb 正是多个 collector 与这个单一消费者之间的功能桥接。
补丁不涉及测试或软件文件。
notes: 在本仓库中，只改 VX_operands.sv 一个文件就足以重现这一体系结构级错误模式。
该故障在多个 collector 并发完成时最明显。
